finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 are rebooked on flights that are still operating, and each has been notified once. No change fees or fare differences were charged. There were no bulletins in effect and no queued requests, so nothing was overridden and no request needed resolving.

Priority order was platinum, then gold, silver, none, with earlier booking date breaking ties. The Takeda/Mensah group (G-7) was handled as one unit at gold priority.

| Reservation | Passenger | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park | UA88 on 3 Aug, business | none |
| R6109 | Iris Vance | UA88 on 3 Aug, **premium economy** | none |
| R6110, R6111 | Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (group G-7) | AA204 on 3 Aug, economy, together | none |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor | DL512 on 3 Aug, economy | 15000 compensation |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad | UA88 on 3 Aug, basic economy | none |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen | AA204 on 3 Aug, **business** | none |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta | AA210 on 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 4 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah | AA210 on 3 Aug, then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 4 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt | AA210 on 3 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation |
| R6107 | Grace Liu | AA206 on 4 Aug, economy | 24000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz | AA206 on 4 Aug, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6105 | Elena Fox | AA204 on 3 Aug, basic economy | none |

- **Upgrades:** Iris (platinum) and Lea (gold) each travel alone on a single flight. Their own cabin was full on a flight that gets them to Chicago sooner than any open seat in their cabin, so each moved up one cabin. Nobody else was upgraded.
- **Dev and Mo:** Neither could make their Boston connection, because no economy seat reached Chicago before the 15:30 departure. Their onward leg was moved to AA1410 on 4 Aug. They land in Boston 17h30m later than scheduled and on a later date, so they get the full compensation plus a hotel voucher.
- **Grace's voucher:** Her compensation was capped at the $240 fare she paid, instead of the standard 30000.
- **Not re-protected:** Nobody was left without a seat.
